children: Malaysia's consumer-price index likely rose 1.8% on year last month, the same pace as in July, according to the median estimate of seven economists polled by The Wall Street Journal. Inflation is expected to be stable, with price pressures contained by targeted fuel subsidies and steady domestic demand, despite higher food prices, DBS economists Taimur Baig and Chang Wei Liang say in a note. The CPI data for August are due Friday. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
